initial_prompts.intro: Apple. How could you be so cold, cold, cold?
initial_prompts.chorus_girl: I thought you was my girl, girl, girl. Now you are just an apple, oh-oh.
initial_prompts.verse_opening: Nineteen, thought I found my wife. Shorty got a new job, workin' at the Five Guys.
initial_prompts.she_broke: She broke my heart. How could you be so cold.
